cards.name: Pass
cards.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, ball speed +1.
cards.special: If passer is WG, may set up scoring.

cards.name: Pass and Run
cards.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, ball speed +1.
cards.special: If passer is MF or SK, may run forward 1.

cards.name: Pinpoint
cards.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, ball speed +1.
cards.special: If passer is PM, may pick a teammate up to 2 spaces.

cards.name: Reset
cards.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, ball speed +1.
cards.special: If Passer is FB or DD, may pass to playmaker.

cards.name: Dribble
cards.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Ball speed +2.
cards.special: If handler is SK, may attempt scoring.

cards.name: Advance
cards.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Ball speed +2.
cards.special: If handler is MF or PM, may advance 1 more space.

cards.name: Spin
cards.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Ball speed +2.
cards.special: If handler is FB or DD, may manipulate ball speed up to dSkill.

cards.name: Drive
cards.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Ball speed +2.
cards.special: If handler is WG, teammate sharing space may take the ball.

cards.name: High Ball
cards.effect: Ball forward 3 spaces, receiver must win a contest, then may set up scoring.
cards.special: If passer is FB or DD, ball may go forward 4 spaces instead.

cards.name: Long shot
cards.effect: Ball forward 3 spaces, receiver must win a contest, then may set up scoring.
cards.special: If passer is PM, ball may go to Striker instead.

cards.name: Set up
cards.effect: Ball forward 3 spaces, receiver must win a contest, then may set up scoring.
cards.special: If passer is MF, ball may go 2 spaces with no contest instead.

cards.name: Vertical Ball
cards.effect: Ball forward 3 spaces, receiver must win a contest, then may set up scoring.
cards.special: If passer is WG or SK, ball may go 0-1 spaces instead.

cards.name: Deflect
cards.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.
cards.special: If defender is a FB, ball goes 1 additional space.

cards.name: Follow
cards.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.
cards.special: If defender is DD or MF, defender may follow.

cards.name: Boot
cards.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.
cards.special: If defender is WG or SK, may set up scoring.

cards.name: Block
cards.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.
cards.special: If defender is PM, ball is contested on the spot.

cards.name: Steal
cards.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Ball skill modifer for skill tests.
cards.special: If defender is PM, can manipulate ball speed up to oSkill.

cards.name: Pickpocket
cards.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Ball skill modifer for skill tests.
cards.special: If defender is MF, don't move back with ball.

cards.name: My Turf!
cards.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Ball skill modifer for skill tests.
cards.special: If defender is FB or DD, gain +3 for a skill test.

cards.name: Toss
cards.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Ball skill modifer for skill tests.
cards.special: If defender is WG or SK, ball to nearest teammate behind while defender stays in place.

cards.name: Pressure
cards.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.
cards.special: If defender is DD, turnover and players don't move.

cards.name: Control
cards.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.
cards.special: If defender is FB or PM, ball to handler's nearest teammate behind. Defender may follow. If reaches goal zone, own goal risk.

cards.name: Stay Close
cards.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.
cards.special: If defender is MF, handler exhausts 1.

cards.name: Stress
cards.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.
cards.special: If defender is SK or WG, ball is contested in place.
